description: Bornes de stationnement is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Castelnaudary. Location of the parking terminals. Parking will be regulated every day except Saturdays and Sundays and public holidays from 9:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. and from 2:00 p.m. to 6:30 p.m. The maximum parking time will be 2 split hours in the same day and on the 9 restricted areas. Coverage: Ville de Castelnaudary. The portal shows the English title as "Parking terminals" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Castelnaudary. Its keywords include borne, horodateur, stationnement. The listing shows 3 download or service links in KMZ, CSV, GEOJSON. The listing shows 2017-03-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
